$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only), once the Actor is public. Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Task names are unique across the whole Apify account, so each carries hiringcafe. Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.
